front: Cost of sales of a manufacturer
back: Opening finished goods + production cost of goods completed (+ purchases of finished goods) − closing finished goods.

front: Where are raw materials and work in progress inventories adjusted?
back: In the manufacturing account; closing figures are also current assets.

front: Where are finished goods inventories adjusted?
back: In cost of sales in the income statement; the closing figure is also a current asset.
Adjust for accruals and prepayments first, then split: factory share to overheads, office share to the income statement.
Factory machinery and buildings: factory overhead. Office equipment and delivery vans: income statement expense.
Bought-in goods for resale are added in cost of sales, not in the manufacturing account.
Statement calculating the production cost of goods completed: raw materials consumed, prime cost, factory overheads and work in progress adjustment.
